info.title: Kobe API
info.description: Team-scoped routes act on the session's active team (spec D9); send X-Kobe-Team on changes. Errors are `{code, message}`. Authentication is the Better Auth session cookie.

get.summary: List the viewer's threads (or a project's readable threads), newest first
get.description: Keyset pagination on (last_activity_at, id). Never Trash. With `q`, full-text search (KOBE-33): web-search syntax (`"phrase"`, `-exclude`, `or`) over user/assistant messages (all terms in one message) and titles (plus fuzzy title matching), ranked by relevance with snippets; `cursor` is then a search cursor and `limit` is capped at 50. Reads Postgres only (never wakes a sandbox).

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

200.description: A page of threads (`ThreadSearchPage` when `q` is given).

409.description: `no_active_team` or `team_mismatch` (stale tab), or a thread conflict.

503.description: `search_timeout`: the search exceeded its time limit.

post.summary: Send a message: starts a run, or queues it behind the thread's active run (D17)
post.description: Owner only. The run is created queued and starts at once when nothing is active and the thread is not interrupted; otherwise `queued` is true and it starts in order (Retry runs first). Follow it with `GET /v1/runs/{id}/events`. `parent_entry_id` branches from an entry (edit-and-regenerate); absent = the thread's leaf when the run starts.

parameters.description: The team the client believes is active. Required on changes; must match.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key (1–128 visible ASCII characters), unique per thread: repeating the request with the same key answers with the run the first one created.

429.description: `budget_exhausted`: no new runs at 100 % of a budget (D30).

post.summary: Resume the queue: after a Stop, or Continue without retry on an interrupted thread (D14)
post.description: Queued runs start in order. No-op unless the thread is interrupted or its queue was paused by a Stop. Returns the thread's runs.

post.summary: Stop: cancel the active run (Pi aborts), or delete a queued message (D17)
post.description: The run ends `cancelled` at once with `run.interrupted {reason: cancelled}`. Stopping the active run pauses the messages queued behind it (`queue_paused`) until the user resumes the queue or sends a new message; deleting a queued message does not pause. Idempotent for a cancelled run.

post.summary: Retry from last entry: re-run an interrupted run as a new run, ahead of the queue
post.description: Only the thread's latest ended run, only if interrupted, at most once (a repeat returns the same retry run). The retry re-sends the original message from the same branch point, so the interrupted branch stays in history (D14).

get.summary: The text of the thread's queued messages and of its active run's prompt
get.description: Messages that are not entries yet: each queued run (in start order, `queue_pos` 1 = next; editable with `PATCH /v1/runs/{id}`) and the active run's message until Pi commits it. Visible like the thread; queued messages only to its owner (a reader of a shared thread gets the active prompt only). Reads Postgres only.

parameters.name: X-Kobe-Team
parameters.description: The team the client believes is active; must match when sent.

200.description: Active run first (while uncommitted), then the queue.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the id is not a uuid.

404.description: `thread_not_found`: unknown id, or another user's or team's thread.
